report.summary: Recommendation: needs review. Not enough evidence: cannot tell whether sql reaches level 2. Estimated levels: py level 3 (needs 2), sql level 1 (needs 2), ds level 1 (needs 1). Confirmed misconception: Believes LEFT JOIN drops left-table rows that have no match, like INNER JOIN. Confirmed misconception: Believes a hash table stores its keys in sorted order, so iterating over it yields keys sorted and it can produce ordered output or the smallest key without extra sorting. Suspected (insufficient corroboration) misconception: Believes a closure (e.g. a lambda defined in a loop) captures the value a variable had when the function was created, rather than looking the variable up when the function is called.
